task.claim:
If Tr beta = 1 then beta - 1 = -beta-bar, so x(beta P - P) = x(beta-bar P).
Formally: for maps beta, beta-bar on an abelian group with
beta P + beta-bar P = P, and any x with x(-Q) = x(Q) for all Q,
x(beta P - P) = x(beta-bar P).
